blurb: Chester Valley Dance Academy offers dance education in a sensitive and friendly atmosphere. Programs include Pre-School Classes (Combo) focusing on ballet and tap, Teen Dance classes in ballet, jazz, modern, and hip hop, a Hip Hop Dance Team for ages 8 and up that competes in spring competitions, and a Company for advanced dancers with multiple performance and master class opportunities. The academy emphasizes technique, performance skills, and backstage etiquette.
